aiConfig.title: AI agent
aiConfig.description: Set up how your agent replies: business instructions, auto-replies, handoff to a person, lead capture, knowledge base and FAQ. AI is included in your plan.
aiConfig.adminOnlyConfig: Only admins and owners can change the AI agent.
aiConfig.encryptionNotice: Your key is encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and never shown again after saving.
aiConfig.embeddingsHint: An OpenAI key used only to embed your knowledge base{sameKeyText}. Leave blank to use keyword search instead. Clear it to turn semantic search off.
aiConfig.sameKeyText: — can be the same key as above
aiConfig.embeddingsModelHint: The model the assistant actually uses to embed your knowledge base and FAQs (the key above only authenticates the request). Changing this only affects new/re-indexed documents — use Reindex in Knowledge base after switching.
aiConfig.behaviourDesc: Tell the assistant about your business — products, tone, what it may and may not promise. This context feeds both drafts and auto-replies.
aiConfig.promptPlaceholder: e.g. We are Acme, a coffee-equipment store. Call yourself "Ava". Be warm and concise. Never quote prices or delivery dates — hand off to a human for those.
aiConfig.enableAssistantDesc: Master switch. Turns on the “Draft with AI” button in the inbox.
aiConfig.autoReplyDesc: The bot answers new inbound messages automatically (only when no flow handles them and no agent is assigned). Hands off to a human when it can’t help.
aiConfig.maxAutoRepliesDesc: After this many bot replies in one thread, the bot goes quiet.
aiConfig.replyDelayDesc: How long the bot waits after its own last reply before answering again. Messages the customer sends during that wait are batched into one reply instead of answered one by one. WhatsApp only — 0 replies immediately.
aiConfig.temperatureDesc: Controls response randomness. Lower is more focused and consistent, higher is more varied and creative. Range 0-2.
aiConfig.handoffToDesc: When the bot can’t help — or hits the reply cap — it pauses and routes the chat here, with a short note on what happened.
aiConfig.handoffQueue: Unassigned queue (any agent can pick it up)
aiConfig.handoffOnMissingInfo: Hand off when the AI lacks information
aiConfig.handoffOnMissingInfoDesc: If the customer asks something the bot doesn't know, it hands off to a human instead of guessing. Turn this off to let it say so honestly and keep the conversation instead of pausing.
aiConfig.leadPipelineDesc: When set, the bot can move contacts through this pipeline's stages as the conversation reveals interest — creating a deal if none exists yet.
aiConfig.statusPlatform: Included in your plan: the platform provides the AI, no key needed.
aiConfig.statusOwn: This account uses its own AI key, set by the platform administrator.
aiConfig.statusNone: AI is not available on this platform yet. Contact the administrator.
aiConfig.limitReached: You reached your plan's monthly limit: the AI is paused and messages go to your team until next month.
aiConfig.migrationPending: Migration 072 must be applied in Supabase before saving.
